author: TECHDEV
description: A zero-dependency CLI that audits decision records (ADRs / RFCs) for governability: reversal conditions, cited evidence, recorded dissent, review date, and owner. Scores each record GOVERNED, GAPS, or UNGOVERNED and gates CI on it. It never judges whether a decision was right, only whether the record is governable.
name: adrgate

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/unit.test.js test/e2e.test.js
